scripts.deploy: npm run build:prod && cp dist/claim-management/browser/index.html dist/claim-management/browser/404.html && npx gh-pages -d dist/claim-management/browser -b gh-pages -m 'Deploy'
scripts.audit:design: npm run audit:colors && npm run audit:spacing
scripts.audit:all: npm run audit:colors && npm run audit:radio-size && npm run audit:formfield-error && npm run audit:imports && npm run audit:any && npm run audit:subscribe && npm run audit:hardcoded-data
scripts.audit:file-size: find src/app -name '*.component.html' | while read f; do lines=$(wc -l < "$f"); if [ $lines -gt 200 ]; then echo "OVER LIMIT $f: $lines lines (max 200)"; fi; done; find src/app -name '*.component.ts' | while read f; do lines=$(wc -l < "$f"); if [ $lines -gt 300 ]; then echo "OVER LIMIT $f: $lines lines (max 300)"; fi; done; find src/app -name '*.component.scss' | while read f; do lines=$(wc -l < "$f"); if [ $lines -gt 250 ]; then echo "OVER LIMIT $f: $lines lines (max 250)"; fi; done
scripts.audit:blessed-comment: find src/app -name '*.component.scss' | xargs grep -l 'display: flex\|display: grid' | xargs grep -rL 'BLESSED:\|blessed\|@see' 2>/dev/null && echo 'Above files have layout code with no blessed citation' || echo 'pass'
scripts.pre-commit: npm run audit:all && npm run audit:ac-logic && npm run audit:ac-route-overrides && npm run audit:stage-pattern && npm run audit:appearance && npm run audit:ndbx-wrapper && npm run audit:wizard-footer
